_comment: Datapack-side declaration: 'when this pack is loaded, use this UI theme'.
The mod reads every data/<ns>/neoorigins/active_theme.json on the server
and picks the LAST one to load as the winner. The chosen id is synced to
every client at login + on /reload, so players never have to touch a
client-side config to see the right look.
Rename '_replace_' below to your pack's namespace (matching the folder
above) and point 'theme' at the id you defined in
